comment: Aliased operations that the automatic corpus deliberately does not cover.
This is the single source of truth: the corpus coverage gate in
crates/ferrosift-operations/tests/corpus.rs reads it to decide what may be
absent, and tools/ledger/generate.mjs reads it to label the ledger. Both
reject an entry that names an unregistered operation or one the corpus now
covers, so an exemption cannot outlive its reason.
scope 'elsewhere' means the operation is byte-pinned, just not by the
automatic corpus. scope 'interoperable' means it is deliberately not
byte-pinned at all, because the reference output is one valid encoding
among several rather than the only one.
